previous_disclosures.summary: As of January 29, 2023, NVIDIA had $11 billion in outstanding senior notes due by 2060 and a $575 million commercial paper program. While the general risks (refinancing, covenants) remain, the quantitative reduction in debt load is a material change in the company's financial position and capital structure risk profile.

comparisons.peer_summary: AMD has an approved stock repurchase program authorizing up to $12 billion in repurchases, with $4.7 billion available as of December 28, 2024, which may be suspended or discontinued at any time and could affect cash reserves and stock volatility.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies disclose capital management and liquidity programs in Item 1A risks, but they differ in the specific instruments used. NVIDIA explicitly cites a $575 million commercial paper program as part of its capital structure. In contrast, AMD discloses a stock repurchase program authorized up to $12 billion, noting that this program may be suspended or discontinued at any time. While NVIDIA focuses on short-term debt instruments for liquidity, AMD focuses on equity buybacks, representing different facets of capital resource management.

sentences.text: We also have a $575 million commercial paper program.
We have an approved stock repurchase program that authorizes repurchases of up to $12 billion of our common stock (Repurchase Program).

comparisons.peer_summary: AMD enters into non-recourse sale and factoring arrangements for certain accounts receivables, which are excluded from indebtedness; however, AMD may face liability or repurchase obligations if commercial disputes arise between AMD and the account debtors.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies disclose arrangements related to managing liquidity and financing risks within their capital structure discussions, though the mechanisms differ. NVIDIA describes a $575 million commercial paper program to support its capital structure. AMD, conversely, details non-recourse sale and factoring arrangements for certain accounts receivables which are excluded from indebtedness but carry potential liability or repurchase obligations in the event of commercial disputes. Both disclosures highlight financial instruments used to manage operational liquidity and capital resources.

sentences.text: We also have a $575 million commercial paper program.

Also, we enter into sale and factoring arrangements from time to time with respect to certain accounts receivables, which arrangements are non-recourse to us in the event that an account debtor fails to pay for credit-related reasons and are not included in our indebtedness.
